responsibility: The master declarative specification of GCC RTL expression codes. Each DEF_RTL_EXPR entry defines an rtx code’s enum name, printed name, operand format string, and class, with embedded documentation for the semantics of individual RTL nodes used both by compiler code and machine-description processing; multiple headers and source files include it to generate enums, tables, and metadata.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the master declarative list of RTL codes, names, formats, classes, and embedded documentation that other files include to generate enums and tables; unlike gcc/rtl.h it does not declare the surrounding C++ API/types, and unlike gcc/rtl.cc it does not define the compiled metadata arrays or utility routines.
